text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on predicting the future distribution of Siamese Eld’s deer under land use and climate change scenarios. While it uses future land use maps as input (developed in prior work by Trisurat et al., 2014a), its primary objective is species distribution modeling, not land use/land cover (LULC) prediction itself. The study area is transboundary (Thailand, Cambodia, Lao PDR) and regional—not national-scale for any single country—and thus fails the core inclusion criterion of explicit national-scale spatial implementation. Furthermore, it meets exclusion criteria: it has a species-specific/ecological focus unrelated to LULC prediction and operates at a transboundary/regional scale rather than national.)
